purpose: Improve sparse_random_01 and line_00 without changing main, I/O, public functionality or correctness; retain earlier gains and check small/large unrelated workloads.
online_status: The measured current body was subsequently submitted as412033:AC29/161ms. See subsequent_online_confirmation for positive and negative observed changes.
changes: Path overload on >4096 vertices: follow a forced initial chain and record its path forward; continue all distances after passing the target; resume normal work if a branch occurs.

Only the forced-prefix specialization defers dense predecessor initialization. Record64 successful relaxations, replay at65 or before radix handoff. Dense and ordinary kernels retain immediate predecessor writes.
Outline prefix specialization and construct separate relax closures at compile time, keeping record-helper captures out of ordinary kernels.
Use65 trivial uninitialized states only for adaptive initial queues on Clang and the GCC prefix specialization. The65th entry triggers immediate radix transfer; no66th insertion is possible.

GCC ordinary kernels retain vector/priority_queue after fixed-array variants reproducibly regressed medium path queries. Use standard greater<State> with the same lexicographic order to reduce emitted code; baseline used a local comparator wrapper.

GCC <=256 uses explicit lexicographic pair comparison preserving exact tie order. Clang <=256 uses packed scalar keys with an early-stop heap that omits the discarded-root store and retains unlimited vector growth.
SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS preprocesses out check-only local_distance and other check-only state. INF mathematical guards and internal capacity safeguards remain.

from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LABELS = ['baseline', 'control', 'original_comparator']
FROZEN_SHA = 'a458ada2b05f7f6ceb04cd9488989132960b71d6344eae80d57a4337959125b1'


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def prepare(conditions, output_name, process_rounds, samples, warmups):
    assert sha(P / 'original_comparator.cpp') == FROZEN_SHA, 'Final source changed'
    binaries = {}
    for compiler in sorted({condition[0] for condition in conditions}):
        for label in LABELS:
            binary = P / 'chain' / f'single_{label}_{compiler}'
            if not binary.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f'Missing prepared binary: {binary}; this script never compiles')
            binaries[f'{compiler}:{label}'] = {'path': str(binary), 'sha256': sha(binary)}
        assert binaries[f'{compiler}:baseline']['sha256'] == binaries[f'{compiler}:control']['sha256'], 'Control must be byte-identical'
    return {
        'source': str(P / 'original_comparator.cpp'), 'source_sha256': FROZEN_SHA,
        'harness': str(P / 'chain' / 'single.cpp'), 'harness_sha256': sha(P / 'chain' / 'single.cpp'),
        'binaries': binaries, 'cpu': 14, 'clock_scope': 'Single implementation per executable; graph generation and cache conditioning outside timer; same API batching and output buffer policy as mixed_broad',
        'process_rounds': process_rounds, 'samples_per_process': samples, 'warmups_per_process': warmups,
        'labels': LABELS, 'conditions': conditions, 'rows': [], 'summaries': [],
        'started_unix': time.time(), 'output_name': output_name,
    }


def write_result(result):
    out = P / result['output_name']
    temporary = out.with_suffix(out.suffix + '.tmp')
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    temporary.replace(out)


def run(conditions, output_name, process_rounds=3, samples=9, warmups=3):
    result = prepare(conditions, output_name, process_rounds, samples, warmups)
    write_result(result)
    with open('/tmp/atcoder_full_performance_20261018/benchmark.lock', 'a') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        for compiler, case, api, mode in conditions:
            groups = {label: [] for label in LABELS}
            for rep in range(process_rounds):
                rotations = [LABELS[shift:] + LABELS[:shift] for shift in range(3)]
                orders = rotations + [list(reversed(order)) for order in rotations]
                order = orders[rep % len(orders)]
                for label in order:
                    binary = P / 'chain' / f'single_{label}_{compiler}'
                    cmd = ['taskset', '-c', '14', str(binary), case, api, mode, str(samples), str(warmups)]
                    started = time.time()
                    row = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(cmd, text=True))
                    assert row['case'] == case and row['api'] == api and row['mode'] == mode
                    assert row['rounds'] == samples and len(row['samples_ns']) == samples
                    row.update(compiler=compiler, label=label, outer_round=rep,
                               process_order=order, command=cmd, process_started_unix=started)
                    result['rows'].append(row)
                    groups[label].append(row['median_ns'])
            medians = {label: statistics.median(values) for label, values in groups.items()}
            changes = {label: (value / medians['baseline'] - 1) * 100 for label, value in medians.items()}
            summary = {'compiler': compiler, 'case': case, 'api': api, 'mode': mode,
                       'median_of_process_medians_ns': medians, 'change_percent': changes,
                       'process_medians_ns': groups}
            result['summaries'].append(summary)
            print(compiler, case, api, mode, {label: round(value, 3) for label, value in changes.items()}, flush=True)
            write_result(result)
    result['finished_unix'] = time.time()
    assert sha(P / 'original_comparator.cpp') == FROZEN_SHA, 'Final source changed during timing'
    for binary in result['binaries'].values():
        assert sha(Path(binary['path'])) == binary['sha256'], 'Binary changed during timing'
    write_result(result)
